title: Adaptive Optimization via Momentum on Variance-Normalized Gradients
summary: We introduce MVN-Grad (Momentum on Variance-Normalized Gradients), an Adam-style optimizer that improves stability and performance by combining two complementary ideas: variance-based normalization and momentum applied after normalization. MVN-Grad scales each coordinate by an exponential moving average of gradient uncertainty and applies momentum to the resulting normalized gradients, removing the cross-time coupling between stale momentum and a stochastic normalizer present in standard Adam-type updates.
